boundaries.read_output_entrypoint: distinct future raw-output entrypoint; not implemented by this candidate

normalization.raw: strict UTF-8; no BOM, duplicate decoded keys or unpaired surrogates; depth <=64, root zero, key/value nesting adds one
normalization.numbers: integer-form tokens only, safe integer range -9007199254740991..9007199254740991; reject negative zero, decimal, exponent and nonfinite tokens before lossy conversion
normalization.canonical: compact strict UTF-8; explicit unsigned UTF-16 key sorting including numeric-looking keys; preserve array order and all decoded text without Unicode/whitespace normalization; JSON short control escapes and lowercase u hex for remaining controls

digest.preimage: For each present record or available page, omit only its own top-level digest property; retain every other property, null and nested record/reference digest. Hash frozen canonical UTF-8; recompute nested records independently before outer page. Never hash supplied own digest over itself.
digest.unavailable_pages: digest=null, visibility_revision=null, items=[], explicit reason; no fabricated record or count
digest.linked_references: null revisions/digests need explicit unavailable reason; available linked metadata is not authority and must match any included canonical record

supplemental_checks: strict raw byte and lexical boundary before schema
exact company/scope equals containing and independently permitted read context for every nested record/reference
page conversation/visibility coherence, unique IDs and per-conversation sequences, included-record reference consistency
decoded UTF-8 byte limits and NUL exclusion

observation.meaning: closed descriptive output metadata, fixed per record revision and included in digest preimage; never authentication, authority or live proof; no new record read timestamp
